description: This pie chart illustrates the distribution of token routing within the FedHLM system, specifically for the EDGE_P2P configuration. The chart contains four slices representing different routing categories. A large, dark green slice labeled “LOCAL” occupies approximately 94.5% of the chart. A smaller, red slice labeled “LLM” represents 3.9% of the total. A light blue slice labeled “EDGE_P2P” accounts for 1.6% of the chart. Finally, a smaller, pink slice is present but does not have a percentage label. The chart includes percentage labels displayed inside each slice, and a legend identifying each category. The slices appear to be ordered from largest to smallest based on their proportional size.
